title: Find a game
changes: The main menu lists open games with real players under your player card. Join with one click, or see all games.
Browse games shows how many games are open and how many people are in them.
Taking over a bot seat between rounds hands you control as soon as the fight ends. If you take over a bot seat, Fresh start refunds its build so you can shop your own.
Custom games keep empty seats open between rounds, and rematches start only when everyone is ready.
The results screen fits one window, shows each player's ping and sits beside the room chat.
Guests keep their plain name, marked by a small icon in the lobby and results.
The account dialog shows your warlock, emblem and name. The wardrobe camera frames close and back views better.
The main menu fits the window without scrolling, with version, What's new and policies in the top-left corner. Maintenance notices only appear when they affect your region.

title: More time to gather
changes: Casual lobbies wait 30 seconds. Choose Wait for players to keep the room open; anyone ready can resume the countdown.
Everyone ready shortens casual and ranked countdowns to 10 seconds, with a clear start warning and sound.
Custom room settings carry over to your next room. Joins, leaves and disconnects appear in room chat.
Spectator winners split the betting pool. Each pick shows its potential payout.
Unfinished matches contribute to combat statistics. Leaving a counted game records a loss when it resolves.
Bots avoid shots that would hit an active Shield; Brutal and Uber punish more openings.
Tiles char as they sink, lava deaths fall more smoothly, and announcer warnings are better timed.
Bugs & feedback is easier to find, with arena screenshots and useful diagnostics. Privacy pages link directly to the feedback form.

title: Clicks reach the arena again
changes: Fixed: in alpha.6 mouse clicks in a match never reached the arena, so right-click opened the browser menu instead of moving.

title: Stay in the game
changes: New Wardrobe: try horns, hats, wings, cape emblems and staffs on a live 3D warlock, then unlock them with Embers. Looks only, never gameplay.
Browse menus and stats without leaving your lobby. Return in one click; hear when ranked finds players.
The menu now hosts ongoing battles between strong bots.
Your account shares one compact menu card. Lobby chat sits below settings, leaving room for the full player roster.
Spectator bets are easier to find, with visible picks and clear open, locked and closed states.
Leaving after 60 seconds of combat counts as a loss when the match ends, including ranked Elo. Rejoin before the end to recover.
Filter online match history by Casual or Ranked and inspect saved builds. What's new shows each update and earlier releases.
Send bugs or feedback from any menu, with a screenshot and useful game context attached automatically.

title: Sharper opponents
changes: Casual games mix Hard bots with one Brutal and one Medium opponent.
Bots punish warlocks who stand still.
Unattended results close after 30 minutes when nobody is ready.
Spell glows render more efficiently.

title: Fairer ranked results
changes: Ranked Elo follows the overall match result, fixing cases where the winner lost rating because of round survival order.

title: Ready when you are
changes: The next match waits until every human player presses Ready.
New game lets you find another room without waiting for a rematch.
When everyone is ready, the lobby countdown drops to five seconds.

title: Louder hits, clearer results
changes: Fireball and Scourge lead the hotbar, with voiced deaths and clearer kill callouts.
Casual matches play to three round wins.
Match history shows the full standings and earned Embers.
Betting closes earlier as the fight narrows.

title: The first public playtest
changes: Casual and ranked multiplayer across US and European servers.
Accounts, a cosmetic collection and guided practice.
Recover your room after a reload or disconnect.
